name: notambourine
description: Claude Code and Codex plugins NoTambourine engineers use to ship client work.

plugins.name: nt-brand
plugins.description: NoTambourine's brand kit: tokens, components, fonts, logos, deck and document export, voice, and doctrine. Copy audits use nt-voice.

plugins.name: nt-dev
plugins.description: Commits, pull requests, issues, end-of-day notes, session recall, and repo cleanup in NoTambourine conventions. Drafts only; hooks point PR and issue writes at their skills and block Unicode dashes in commits.

plugins.name: nt-pm
plugins.description: Drafts client call agendas and follow-ups, deploy notes, and weekly recaps in plain English, and shares files through Drive. Posts only where a client context opts in and never deploys. Client facts live outside this repo.

plugins.name: nt-voice
plugins.description: Edits prose so it reads as written by a person: a light phrasing pass for an authored draft, or a full rewrite for a machine draft.

plugins.name: nt-seo-spider
plugins.description: Screaming Frog SEO Spider MCP plus a crawl skill that sizes each run to its task. Requires SEO Spider 24+ with MCP running; disabled by default because it provides 29 tools.

plugins.name: nt-shopify
plugins.description: Refuses Shopify CLI and Shopify MCP calls that write to a live storefront. Development themes are the only writable surface, Hydrogen and app deploys are refused, and unknown verbs fail closed.

plugins.name: nt-vendor
plugins.description: Third-party skills mirrored from their upstream repositories. The nt-vendor prefix marks work that is not ours.

plugins.name: wormhook
plugins.description: Blocks npm/PyPI supply-chain malware and agent-hijack persistence at the Claude Code hook before it runs.
